correctness.rationale: Odd anticommutation in odd characteristic reduces the edge test to zero degree-two and degree-four products. For v≠0, the label (projective v, normalized pairing divided by the scalar of v) specifies a clique of size s; the v=0 clique joins these by point–hyperplane incidence. Counting hyperplanes through one or two points gives NᵀN=q²I+(q+1)J. The clique, dual-scalar and label contrasts have the asserted scalar eigenvalues; the nonconstant incidence modes couple by q√[(q−1)qs]=s and give the golden pair. The singleton zero and two global constants give precisely Q_q. Total dimension is q⁸. Independently, writing D=q⁴−1 and l=q³−1, expansion gives det Q_q=D[1−s+q⁴(2l−D+1)]=−D[q⁷(q−2)+q³(q−1)−1]; it is strictly negative for q≥3. The other blocks also exclude zero. These counts use finite-field dimensions and hold also over extensions.
residual_risks: The recorded numerical compression check is finite; the incidence proof, not its reported precision, covers all odd prime powers. Loops, characteristic two, and removing zero would change the claim.
